title: Quick Yeasty French Apple Galette
description: A crispy and indulgent French dish featuring applesauce and roast apples, perfect for dessert. This galette is made with a yeasty crust and can be enjoyed raw or roasted.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Add the melted butter and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough into a large circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Spread the applesauce over the center of the dough, leaving a 1 inch border.
Arrange the roast apples over the applesauce.
Fold the edges of the dough over the apples to form a crust.
Brush the crust with the beaten egg.
Bake the galette in a preheated oven at 375 degrees for 25 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
